title: Dyed Bundles x Bare Bones
description: Adapt the look of Dyed Bundles to the Bare Bones style
body:
I found the amazing mode [Dyed Bundle](https://modrinth.com/mod/dyed-bundles) that alowed me to aply color on my bundles, but it changed the texture of the bundles to the default, and because I'm a huge fan of the Bare Bones style, I decide to make this resource pack to adapt the looks for this mod :D **So remember, it only works if you have the mod too.**

![examples](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c36380ea35bbaf2eff405396af787e4f4ed98fb4.png)

Enjoy!

Contact me on my discord (seiyadipessego) if you have any problem with it.
